name: mtdt
description: mtdt.io MCP: Salesforce DevOps platform connector (metadata deployments, backups and more)

interface.longDescription:
Use mtdt.io to work with the Salesforce orgs connected to your team. Find source and target orgs, inspect deployment history, browse metadata, and prepare deployments from an org, a Git repository, or a usable metadata backup. Run pre-deployment checks for dependencies, target conflicts, permissions, and backup recommendations. Validate a selected package with Apex tests, follow its status, and quick-deploy a successful validation. You can also start metadata backups and inspect their progress.

The package includes deployment and troubleshooting skills. It connects to the hosted mtdt.io MCP server using browser-based OAuth sign-in. You need an mtdt.io account and connected Salesforce orgs. Viewing requires the mtdt:read scope; tools that create deployments, retrieve metadata, validate, or run backups require mtdt:deploy. Your team roles and target approval policies still apply. Validation checks the package without deploying its metadata to the target; quick-deploy and direct deployment can overwrite target metadata. Preflight findings are advisory and require review before a deployment.
defaultPrompt: Show my connected Salesforce orgs and recent deployments.
Check a Salesforce metadata deployment before validation.
Help me understand why my last deployment failed.

publication.release_notes: Adds the OpenAI/Codex directory package with the hosted MCP connection, deployment and troubleshooting skills, listing assets, and review cases. Updates MFA troubleshooting guidance.
